#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FDH Hall of Fame — One-shot setup script.
Run from inside ~/fantasy-newsletter:
    python3 setup_hof.py
"""
import base64, os
from pathlib import Path

FILES = {
  "assets/css/fdh.css": "",
  "assets/js/fdh.js": "",
  "templates/index.html": "",
  "templates/hof.html": "",
  "templates/standings.html": "",
  "templates/rivalries.html": "",
  "templates/trades.html": "",
  "templates/draft.html": "",
  "templates/records.html": "",
  "scripts/fetch_sleeper.py": "",
  "scripts/generate_site.py": "",
  "scripts/build.py": "",
  ".github/workflows/deploy.yml": ""
}

def main():
    root = Path.cwd()
    print("\n=== FDH Hall of Fame Setup ===")
    print(f"Installing into: {root}\n")
    for dest, b64 in FILES.items():
        path = root / dest
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(b64))
        print(f"  OK  {dest}")
    # Create empty _data folder and docs/hof placeholder
    (root / "_data").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root / "docs" / "hof").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print("\n✅ Setup complete!")
    print("   Next: python3 scripts/fetch_sleeper.py")
    print("   Then: python3 scripts/generate_site.py")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
